question: Should Legion Capital move 40% of its payment volume (about ₹600 crore a month) from Arvanta Payments to Brevis Pay?

options.A: Stay with Arvanta Payments for 100% of volume
options.B: Move 40% of volume to Brevis Pay

constraints: Payment data must be stored and processed only in India
A decision is needed within 2 weeks
No more than one gateway migration this financial year
Overall payment success rate must not fall

criteria.name: Cost
criteria.good_looks_like: Lower total cost after any fixes needed

criteria.name: Security & compliance
criteria.good_looks_like: Meets every data, security and regulatory rule; a blocking finding overrides the score

criteria.name: Reliability
criteria.good_looks_like: No drop in payment success rate or uptime

criteria.name: Growth
criteria.good_looks_like: Unlocks new merchants and products; meets the vendor-concentration OKR

criteria.name: Customer impact
criteria.good_looks_like: Fewer complaints, faster settlements and refunds, lower churn

context: Legion Capital Ltd: Fictional RBI-registered NBFC (digital personal and SME loans) with a merchant checkout product, Legion Pay. All payment volume currently goes through Arvanta Payments; Brevis Pay has run a 2% pilot since August 2026.
